epic.summary: Growth: Search generation history by prompt text
epic.why: Users cannot find their old generations on the web-app history page — it is an undifferentiated infinite scroll. Letting a user type part of a prompt and see matching generations makes their own creative history retrievable, cutting frustration and abandonment on the history page.

milestones.name: Searchable backend
milestones.goal: The generation history API can return a user's generations filtered by a prompt-text substring, backed by an index so search stays fast on large histories.

milestones.name: History search UI
milestones.goal: A user can type part of a prompt on the history page and see only the matching generations.

size_estimate.rationale: Single Prisma migration adding a text-search index (e.g. pg_trgm) on the generation prompt column; no application logic, additive and reversible.

items.one_line_summary: Add prompt-text search index migration for generations

size_estimate.rationale: Add a prompt-text filter param to the generation history endpoint: query builder change, user-scoped filtering, pagination preserved. One focused PR; depends on the index from i1.

items.one_line_summary: Add prompt-text filter to generation history endpoint

size_estimate.rationale: Add a debounced search input to the history page wired to the new filter param, with empty/no-results states; consumes i2's endpoint.

items.one_line_summary: Add prompt search input to history page
